source: International Institute for Population Sciences, National Family Health Survey: NFHS-6 (2023-24) India and state fact sheets (total, urban and rural columns), which also print the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure. Indicators: people aged 60 and over, and people under 15, each as a share of the people in the surveyed households. 34 states and UTs with data; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no figure in the sheets used. Survey estimates, not a census count.
hook_vo: Kerala's share aged sixty and over matched its share under fifteen.
